description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys component, specifically testing the creation of key sessions within the Rialto media server. It defines a test fixture class and two test cases: one for successful creation and one for failure due to OCDM system failure.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysCreateKeySessionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeysTestBase, used to set up and tear down media key creation for testing createKeySession functionality.

methods.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysCreateKeySessionTest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes media keys with a specific key system.

methods.name: ~RialtoServerMediaKeysCreateKeySessionTest
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up media keys.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test case verifying that createKeySession successfully creates a session and returns a valid session ID.

methods.name: OcdmSystemFailure
methods.description: Test case verifying that createKeySession fails appropriately when OCDM creation fails.
